messages:
tina (Product Ops): Quick mid-quarter check from product side — can we get a super-compact tally of milestone state for Q3 okr: runtime optimizations, dedicated rollout, and canary metrics? Who owns final signoff for the dedicated capacity handoff?
jamie (PM): Owners: runtime optimizations -> sasha, dedicated rollout -> oliver, canary metrics -> jamie.
jamie (PM): Goal: note what shipped this week, what slipped, blockers, and any CR/merge pings. Keep it short.
sasha (Eng): Shipped: continuous batching perf fix (PR merged). Slipped: KV-cache prefetch experiment (still flaky on long seq). Blocker: need eng-infra to provision extra d4 nodes for perf tests. @oliver can you confirm infra ETA? :pray:
oliver (Staff Eng): infra ETA: provision request in flight, expect nodes by EOD tomorrow. Will follow up in eng-infra channel if anything changes.
sasha (Eng): CR pings: @maria and @eli please take a quick look at <https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2345|runtime#2345> — small perf tweak, needs a +1 to deploy.
jamie (PM): Canary metrics: observed 5% p99 improvement for small-batch paths on the latest runtime image. Canary still running in us-west-2. No user-facing regressions yet.
tina (Product Ops): Nice. For the dedicated rollout: timeline still targeted next wed. Who's owning the handoff doc?
oliver (Staff Eng): I own the handoff doc. Draft is at <https://docs.internal/r/redwood/dedicated-handoff|dedicated-handoff>. Status: draft -> review. Need confirmation on backup KMS config from security.
sasha (Eng): Dependency: security KMS confirmation -> @security on-call. Also need dedicated capacity acceptance test from QA — pinging @qa-lead in separate thread.
jamie (PM): What slipped from committed milestones? Sasha listed KV-cache prefetch — what impact on OKR?
sasha (Eng): Impact: prefetch experiment was supposed to reduce token tail latency by 8% for seq>1k; slipping means we'll miss that specific target this quarter unless we convert a smaller scoped fix. Suggest we pivot to fallback: a lightweight prefetch that covers common seq shapes (70% of traffic).
jamie (PM): Agree — propose we log that as a scope reduction: keep top-level OKR, but mark prefetch as stretch and add the fallback as committed. Tina: ok to update milestone board?
tina (Product Ops): Yep, I'll mark prefetch as stretch and add fallback as committed. Will update owners and notify customers on the outstanding ETA.
oliver (Staff Eng): Quick note: dedicated rollout still depends on config for autoscale policy. Sasha, can you file the autoscale knobs you need (min/max/scale-step)?
sasha (Eng): Filed: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/891|platform#891> — min=2, max=50, scale-step=4 for initial.
jamie (PM): CR/merge summary: runtime#2345 (sasha) -> merged; infra#1120 (oliver) -> awaiting review; dedicated-handoff doc -> oliver review in progress.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment to us-west-2 started at 2026-03-20T14:05:12Z. Image: runtime:v3.4-canary. Metric hooks attached.
sasha (Eng): Follow-ups: i'll queue a short retro on the prefetch experiment in next week’s eng sync. For now i'll start the fallback implementation tomorrow.
jamie (PM): Action list (short): 1) oliver: finish handoff doc + KMS confirm (ETA EOD tomorrow). 2) infra: provision d4 nodes (ETA EOD tomorrow). 3) sasha: fallback prefetch PR by Thurs, ping reviewers. 4) tina: update milestone board and notify external stakeholders.
tina (Product Ops): Done — milestone board updated and stakeholder note drafted, will send once oliver confirms KMS.
oliver (Staff Eng): Confirmed: KMS question answered by security. I'll finish handoff doc and drop link here when ready.
sasha (Eng): Thanks everyone. Quick ask: if reviewers are free, please glance at runtime#2345 and the new fallback PR when it appears — two small reviews should get this over the line. :thumbsup:
jamie (PM): Thanks team — will check back Friday for a quick status snapshot.
